zh-CN.title: 唱片铺的生活纹样
items: 四款歌手气泡换上各自的配色与生活纹样，灵感来自扑克魔术、棒球、老车和手冲咖啡。
在个性化的聊天气泡「典藏」分类中，可以预览四款气泡并试听侧边光盘。

en.title: Everyday Details for Record Shop Bubbles
items: The four artist bubbles have new colors and motifs inspired by card magic, baseball, vintage cars, and pour-over coffee.
Preview all four designs and play their album clips in the Legendary category of Chat Bubble personalization.
